source_policy: complete program is supplied to evidence extraction, candidate assessment, and repair planning; narrowing receives compact validated summaries
oracle_policy: EXACT_ORACLE makes test_status absolute and supplies expected_output; NO_EXACT_ORACLE treats test_status as uncertain and supplies no output oracle
candidate_order_policy: FAL determines Top-N membership; all downstream candidates are in source-line order and every candidate is evidence-assessed
anchor_policy: select only candidates with support/strong_support and a supporting testcase or MR verdict; never fill from FAL rank
